description: Election Commission - Declare that S. A. S. G. Samarasinghe was selected as the member of the Kandy Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Kandy Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
